method: Apply published 0.8.1 all-result and role-scoped exclusions to already current-edition source-first 0.8.0 analysis; maintain status-specific certainty limits, record blob baseline, mapping preservation, and episode-by-episode dispositions. Direct external sources not re-fetched.

outcomes.title: Uber algorithmic fare variation drew scrutiny over personalised pricing
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-052 Boundary remains engaged by allegedly misleading AI-enabled booking-offer reference prices/discount framing in a decision-directed commercial interface. The algorithmic offer seeks a purchase decision and the cited description addresses a specific purported saving; it is not merely fare variation or unactioned generic content. Neither the contested reference-price premise nor an actual matched informed-choice impairment is determined; the v0.8.1 all-results exclusions for purposeless deception, merely uncomfortable disagreement or unused content cannot be affirmatively applied. The source dispute and corrected Consumer Reports collection errors remain explicit. E002 mapped Boundary; no positive failure is inferred.
outcomes.scope: Bounded exclusion-role delta only; no new external evidence, taxonomy mapping, source clause finding, harm or external governance decision.

outcomes.title: AI-generated immigration-attorney impersonation reportedly defrauded Bronx resident of $4,820
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-079 failure rests on AI-generated false attorney professional identity and the resulting solicited/paid immigration service. FC-082 is separately evidenced by the false lawyer-affiliation trust pathway inducing disclosure of Social Security/residency documents, an independently consequential data-disclosure action alongside payment, so the v0.8.1 all-results economic-only exclusion does not subsume it. FC-052 has a distinct victim transfer and document-disclosure choice executed via the fabricated AI advertisement, not an unmobilised persona or mere trust-cue existence. FC-053 is materially identifiable person-bound synthesis without authority, not simply attribution. The record does not attribute criminal intent or generator internals to the model.
outcomes.scope: Bounded exclusion-role delta only; no new external evidence, taxonomy mapping, source clause finding, harm or external governance decision.

outcomes.title: ASIC reported AI-generated public-figure investment impersonation scams caused A$7.4 million in FY26 losses
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-079 is material false investment solicitation and the reported aggregate campaign loss, not an amount assigned to any particular generated article. FC-082 also has a separately evidenced AI-mediated engineered institutional/social-proof trust pathway: impersonated named public figures, fake investment news, comments and multi-stage lead capture that induced disclosure/contact independently of the payment premise. FC-052 separately concerns influenced investment choices under a human-selected but materially AI-executed tactic. FC-053 concerns unauthorised name/likeness-bound synthesis by operators, not unknown model internals. The v0.8.1 all-results economic-only, merely generic drafting, incidental-AI and identity-without-influence exclusions do not negate these separate evidenced mechanisms; case-specific dollar allocation and full containment remain unestablished.
outcomes.scope: Bounded exclusion-role delta only; no new external evidence, taxonomy mapping, source clause finding, harm or external governance decision.

outcomes.title: Concurrent ChatGPT, Claude and Grok service outages on 3 September 2026
outcomes.criterion_screen: Retain unclassified and complete source-clause coverage: simultaneous service disruptions across three providers do not independently establish an applicable user-level or customer-level usable-availability threshold or mandated response under FC-084. The new v0.8.1 all-results class-scope exclusion for an outage without an independently applicable continuity requirement prevents treating incident popularity or adverse outcome alone as service-governance failure or Boundary. Neither cross-provider common causation, final recovery compliance nor full response-signal delivery is inferred. All nine source clauses remain resolved-no-mapping.
outcomes.scope: Bounded exclusion-role delta only; no new external evidence, taxonomy mapping, source clause finding, harm or external governance decision.

outcomes.title: Hermes agent ran unattended during intrusion into Thailand’s Ministry of Finance
outcomes.criterion_screen: Retain unclassified, partial E005 hold. Publicly recovered malware infrastructure and unattended Hermes configuration document activity, but no evidenced required operative human-approval control is shown to have failed to activate: disabling prompts by operator is not the same as a requirement governing the operator. FC-083 v0.8.1 all-results exclusions for no applicable activated control remain relevant, and no specific AI-authored additional target-state transfer satisfies FC-057 on the evidence. Thai CERT/NCSA acknowledgement does not prove completed repair or full signalling disposition. E005 unresolved.
outcomes.scope: Bounded exclusion-role delta only; no new external evidence, taxonomy mapping, source clause finding, harm or external governance decision.

outcomes.title: DeepSeek exposed an unauthenticated database containing chat histories and secrets
outcomes.criterion_screen: Retain provisional-classified FC-042 success for the bounded Wiz-to-DeepSeek disclosure-and-remediation pathway. A governance notification was actually produced, reached a capable service operator, and its exposed service state was promptly secured per Wiz. The v0.8.1 all-results class exclusion for no produced signal does not apply, nor does an authorised rejection or audit-only omission. This is evidence of a specific corrected exposure, not proof of no earlier access, complete recovery of leaked data, or general service security. Separate underlying exposure clauses are unclassified and not converted into success.
outcomes.scope: Bounded exclusion-role delta only; no new external evidence, taxonomy mapping, source clause finding, harm or external governance decision.

outcomes.title: Gemini image-generation tuning produced historically inaccurate depictions and over-broad refusals
outcomes.criterion_screen: Retain FC-043 failure: Google expressly acknowledged excessive people-image safety refusal on benign prompts with no valid harmful-content trigger, while the refusal control nevertheless operated. This identifies misactivation rather than a correctly triggered but overstrong control, stale residual state, or mere upstream factual error. The v0.8.1 class-scope exclusion for technical capability treated as authority does not describe the incident. Historical image inaccuracy is retained separately as occurrence context without inventing an additional taxonomy admission. E002 remains the sole mapped clause.
outcomes.scope: Bounded exclusion-role delta only; no new external evidence, taxonomy mapping, source clause finding, harm or external governance decision.
